project: Step 1 Bring-up (Odin + wlroots + small C shim)
goal: Start a compositor that can show xdg-shell toplevel windows (nested first), with a frame loop rendering via wlr_scene.

steps.description: Autocreate and return *wlr_backend using the wl_display.
Create and return *wlr_renderer compatible with the backend.
Create and return *wlr_allocator for buffer allocation.
Create compositor globals clients expect (wlr_compositor, wlr_subcompositor, etc.).
Create and return *wlr_output_layout to manage output positioning.
Create and return *wlr_scene_output_layout to connect scene outputs to the output layout.
Create and return *wlr_xdg_shell to support xdg-shell clients (normal app windows).
Create and return *wlr_seat (input seat), even if full input handling comes later.
C shim: register backend new_output signal and forward events to an Odin callback with (userdata, *wlr_output).
C shim: register xdg_shell new_surface signal and forward events to an Odin callback with (userdata, *wlr_xdg_surface).
Handle new output: pick preferred mode, enable+commit, add to output layout, create scene output, then register the frame listener.
C shim: register output frame signal and forward events to an Odin callback with (userdata, *wlr_output).
Per frame: begin render, clear background, render/commit the wlr_scene for this output, end render + commit.
On new xdg_surface: if role is toplevel, create a wlr_scene_xdg_surface node attached to the root scene and position it (e.g., 0,0).
Start the wlroots backend; return success/failure.

callbacks_expected.description: Odin callback invoked by C shim; calls output_init(server, output).
Odin callback invoked by C shim; calls view_init_from_xdg_surface(server, xdg_surface).
Odin callback invoked by C shim; calls output_handle_frame(server, output).

shim_api_minimal.signature: void shim_register_new_output_listener(struct wlr_backend *backend, void *userdata, void (*cb)(void *userdata, struct wlr_output *output));
shim_api_minimal.description: Registers backend->events.new_output and forwards output pointer to cb.

shim_api_minimal.signature: void shim_register_new_xdg_surface_listener(struct wlr_xdg_shell *xdg_shell, void *userdata, void (*cb)(void *userdata, struct wlr_xdg_surface *surface));
shim_api_minimal.description: Registers xdg_shell->events.new_surface and forwards surface pointer to cb.

shim_api_minimal.signature: void shim_register_output_frame_listener(struct wlr_output *output, void *userdata, void (*cb)(void *userdata, struct wlr_output *output));
shim_api_minimal.description: Registers output->events.frame and forwards output pointer to cb.
